WITH rating_inventory AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS stock_count
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(stock_count) AS avg_stock
  FROM rating_inventory
),
above_average_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    ri.stock_count,
    (ri.stock_count - ra.avg_stock) AS above_average_distance
  FROM rating_inventory ri
  CROSS JOIN rating_average ra
  WHERE ri.stock_count > ra.avg_stock
)
SELECT 
  SUM(stock_count) AS total_above_average,
  AVG(above_average_distance) AS avg_distance_above_average
FROM above_average_ratings
